verdict.reasoning: The printed page 789 (printed folio 765) shows a two-column layout: the header 'Script or / character / classification' on three lines with 'Letters or range of letters', then 'Latin:' followed by two wrapped lines of ranges. The markdown keeps every word of the header and every code range in the same order: 0041-005A ... 01BC-01BF in the table row, then 01C0-01C3, 01C4-021F, 0222-0233, 0250-02AD, 1E00-1E9B, 1EA0-1EF9, 207F directly below it. I compared each range with the page and found no value missing, added or changed. The only difference is how the transcription laid out a wrapped header and a wrapped cell. That is a line-wrapping and formatting artifact. A careful reader can still recover the full content without ambiguity, since nothing else sits between the row and its continuation. The claim's 'pdf_says' and 'markdown_says' are quoted accurately, but the difference does not change meaning.
